text:
maya: FYI pushed up the first quant-sanity run for auklet13b across regions. looking for quick eyes on weird quality deltas + kernel choices. dashboard: https://internal.redwood/bench/1738501123 :wave:
infra-bot: job completed: quant-sanity/auklet13b/1738501123 (artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/auklet13b/1738501123) :white_check_mark:
sam: quick skim — H100 FP8 shows big speedup on p50 for 128-token gen, ~1.9x vs FP16. A100 INT8 is only ~1.3x. numbers attached in csv snippet below.
rachel: saw a consistent quality bump (worse) for FP8 in eu-west on convo prompts, delta ~+2.1 ppl vs FP16. examples show repeated token collapse on long-turns.
jon: curious about kernels used — were these runs using fused-attn-v2 or fallback kernels? kernel choice can change perf/quality tradeoffs.
maya: ran H100 with fused-attn-v2 + fused-kv, A100 with split-kv fallback. included kernel column in csv. also used default quant-config v2 (per-channel symmetric scaling). here is the command we used:
```
./bench/run_quant_sanity.sh --model auklet13b --regions us-east-1,eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1 \n  --gpus h100,a100 --profiles fp16,bf16,int8,fp8 --kernels fused-attn-v2,split-kv \n  --seqs 128,512 --batch 4 --eval-set conv_small,docqa_smoke
```
arjun: FP8 runs used blockwise 64 scaling and per-tensor clamp, maybe try per-channel clamp for FP8 on eu-west to see if that fixes token collapse. also try quant-debias on the embedding layer.
sam: attaching short CSV extract (headers):
```
region,gpu,profile,kernel,seq,p50_ms,speedup_vs_fp16,delta_ppl
us-east-1,h100,fp16,fused-attn-v2,128,42,1.00,0.0
us-east-1,h100,fp8,fused-attn-v2,128,22,1.91,+1.7
eu-west-1,h100,fp8,fused-attn-v2,512,205,1.65,+2.1
ap-southeast-1,a100,int8,split-kv,128,60,1.32,+0.9
eu-west-1,a100,int8,split-kv,512,430,1.25,+1.4
```
rachel: note that delta_ppl is median over 3 prompt sets; the convo_small set drives the FP8 regression. I can dump a few failing generations to the artifacts bucket.
eval-bot: eval run summary: fp8_us-east_128 PASS (quality delta < +2.0), fp8_eu_512 FAIL (+2.1 > +2.0 threshold), int8_a100_all PASS. See /evals/auklet13b/1738501123/report.html
jon: try this quick experiment: on eu-west1 H100 FP8 switch kernel -> fused-attn-v2 + disable-auto-kernel-fallback, enable per-channel FP8 clamp. small run with 50 prompts should show if it's kernel or quant-config.
maya: will run that tonight and re-upload. plan: if FP8 in eu-west still fails, we'll roll fp8 only in us-east + ap-southeast and leave eu on fp16 for canary.
arjun: also propose a hybrid profile: FP8 for first N layers then INT8 for top layers — mitigates generation collapse and keeps perf. low-effort to prototype in quant-config.
sam: one more ops note: when routing policy is cross-region fallback, make sure model-variant labels include quant-profile tag so fallbacks pick compatible kernels. saw a mis-route once where eu fell back to an fp16-only host and caused errors.
maya: thanks everyone. i'll upload the kernel-switch run id 1738501600 and link here when done. :thumbsup:
